deterministic.proposal:
PROCEDURE count_calls_for_time_person(time:TIME)
$v0 = CALL person_on_call_at time={time}
$v1 = CALL count_calls_with person=$v0
RETURN $v1
END

external.program:
PROCEDURE count_calls_for_time_person()
$v0 = CALL person_on_call_at time=10
$v1 = CALL count_calls_with person=$v0
RETURN $v1
END
